property_summary: For every admissible initialize(...) call, the contract's public feeRate getter equals the provided _feeRate argument; the mutant assigns changeFee to feeRate instead, so for some inputs feeRate != _feeRate and the property is violated.
change_summary: Replace the feeRate assignment to mistakenly assign changeFee instead of _feeRate, changing feeRate to the provided changeFee value.
